fn drain<T: Copy>(controls: &mut [Consumer<T>])
where
    T: Default,
{
    'lanes: for control in controls.iter_mut() {
        let available = control.available_at_entry();
        'records: for _ in 0..available {
            let Ok(record) = control.try_pop() else {
                continue 'lanes;
            };
            apply(record);
        }
    }
}
